expectations.text: It rejects the required disclosure dropdown, replacing it with an optional open question about what the attendee needs to attend, never a mandatory disability selection.

expectations.text: It rejects routing responses to the info@ role alias, requiring a named person who reads and answers requests.

expectations.text: It requires the data-handling posture decided before the channel opens, covering retention, who can access requests, and the reply turnaround as the published minimum.

expectations.text: It states a published reply turnaround that applies to declines as well as acceptances.

expectations.text: It explains the trade the registration-field route makes: it surfaces the most needs, which is exactly what generates months of triage - effort counted as triage generated, not setup minutes.
